title: Reserve declaration
description: What a reserve declares at publishing, attributable to its maker. A later version that changes either answer is a new declaration, with a new declared_in_version. REQ-CAT-6, REQ-ORD-13, REQ-AUZ-9.

can_require_user_initiated_withdrawal.description: Whether the reserve can require that the user initiate the withdrawal themselves. Where false, the operator may act for the user (REQ-AUZ-9).

starts_routes_on_automatic_deposits.description: Whether the reserve starts routes on automatic deposits (REQ-ORD-13).

maker.description: The party the declaration is attributable to.

declared_in_version.description: The provider version in which this declaration was made.
